Trump Advocates for Permanent Daylight Saving Time

Former U.S. President Donald Trump has renewed his push to make Daylight Saving Time (DST) permanent. He claimed that making DST permanent would reduce the nation's murder rate. Trump also stated that this is a cause both sides of the political aisle could unite behind. The push aims to pass a bill that would enact this change.
